g.text: Is it fair to assume normal distributions?
Central Limit Theorem: distribution of cases → distribution of averages
Not shown: heavy tails — usually fine too, just hard to draw at this scale. (Some infinite-variance ones don’t satisfy the CLT.)
• Your weird score shapes are fine — the distribution of the average is still ≈ Normal.
• Many re-runs (M) are how you map that distribution out — each run is one draw from it.
• Its width is σ/√N̅: more questions narrow it; the scores’ own spread σ doesn’t change.
